content.raw:
Medical microbiology provides the laboratory testing behind the diagnosis and treatment of infections. The laboratories at our partner hospital support inpatient, outpatient and emergency care across bacteriology, virology, parasitology, mycology, molecular microbiology and infection immunology, with a broad and regularly updated test panel. MedLuxLife coordinates sample collection during your visit and ensures your results are translated and shared with your doctors.

Treatments and services

Bacteriology

Identification of bacteria and antibiotic susceptibility testing, combining classical culture with rapid confirmatory methods and same-day stained microscopy.

Mycobacteriology (tuberculosis)

Isolation and identification of acid-fast organisms such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Mycobacterium avium complex, including molecular methods and the Quantiferon TB Gold test.

Virology

Antigen and antibody serology, sensitive detection of HIV and hepatitis agents, and confirmatory testing where needed.

Parasitology

Diagnosis of parasitic infections using classical methods supported by serological tests.

Mycology

Identification of yeasts, dermatophytes and moulds, plus galactomannan antigen testing for suspected aspergillus infection in immunocompromised patients.

Molecular microbiology

PCR-based detection, genotyping and viral load testing, including viruses monitored after transplantation.

Syndromic molecular panels

Rapid multiplex testing of blood cultures, respiratory, gastrointestinal, cerebrospinal and joint fluid samples, with simultaneous detection of resistance genes.

Infection immunology

Immunological tests that support the diagnosis of infectious diseases.

Round-the-clock service

The laboratory operates 24 hours a day and works closely with clinicians on diagnosis and treatment.

Selected tests

  • Bacterial culture and antibiotic susceptibility testing
  • Stained microscopy of clinical samples
  • Acid-fast bacteria staining
  • Quantiferon TB Gold
  • Galactomannan antigen test
  • Hepatitis B virus DNA
  • Hepatitis C virus RNA
  • Varicella zoster virus (VZV)
  • Epstein-Barr virus (EBV DNA)
  • Cytomegalovirus (CMV DNA)
  • Polyomavirus (BK/JC virus)
  • Human papillomavirus (HPV DNA) and genotyping
  • Viral load tests
  • MRSA (real-time PCR)
  • VRE (real-time PCR)
  • Neisseria gonorrhoeae (real-time PCR)
  • Chlamydia (real-time PCR)
  • Syndromic panels for blood culture, respiratory, gastrointestinal, CSF and joint fluid samples
  • Resistance gene detection

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous culture, serology or PCR results
  • A list of recent antibiotic treatments

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Medical Microbiology consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
